svg.title: From $1,125,000 Retail Sales to $129,375 Owner Net
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-base-retail-margin-waterfall; chart type: waterfall; title: From $1,125,000 Retail Sales to $129,375 Owner Net; subtitle: Six bars reconcile the canonical Base-Case 11.5% net margin.; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: USD per year. The first bar is the opening revenue total, the next four bars are signed expense changes, and the final bar is the closing total, not an additional change. Canonical gross revenue means retail sales net of refunds. Expense allocations are illustrative and include paid pod labor.; caption: $1,125,000 − $540,000 − $135,000 − $180,000 − $140,625 = $129,375; $129,375 ÷ $1,125,000 = 11.5%. Collected sales tax is excluded from revenue.; stages: label: Opening total: recognized annual retail sales; value: $1,125,000 revenue after refunds; 100% of sales; numeric value: 1125000.0; detail: Use Shopify order records and accounting adjustments to reconcile net retail sales. Do not deduct refunds again or substitute net processor deposits for revenue.; label: Subtract landed cost of goods sold; value: −$540,000 annual expense; 48% of recognized sales; numeric value: -540000.0; detail: Include purchase cost, allocated inbound freight, applicable duties, and inventory-loss expense. Unsold inventory remains an asset until sold or written down.; label: Subtract fulfillment, payments, and return handling; value: −$135,000 annual expense; 12% of recognized sales; numeric value: -135000.0; detail: Include 3PL storage and handling, outbound shipping, payment processing, and reverse logistics. Refund principal already reduces opening revenue and is not repeated.; label: Subtract advertising and variable acquisition spend; value: −$180,000 annual expense; 16% of recognized sales; numeric value: -180000.0; detail: Allocate media and directly variable acquisition charges here. Retained contribution after these three expense bars is $270,000, or 24% of sales.; label: Subtract labor and remaining operating overhead; value: −$140,625 annual expense; 12.5% of recognized sales; numeric value: -140625.0; detail: Budget $96,000 loaded labor for two full-time seats, $24,000 for three limited-hour contractors, and $20,625 for software, insurance, and remaining overhead. Validate local staffing costs; fixed overhead averages $11,718.75 monthly.; label: Closing total: canonical annual owner net profit; value: $129,375 residual profit; 11.5% annual net margin; numeric value: 129375.0; detail: This closing bar equals revenue less all four expense bars. Paid owner labor, if included in the pod, belongs in labor expense; personal tax treatment is not modeled.

rect.title: label: Opening total: recognized annual retail sales; value: $1,125,000 revenue after refunds; 100% of sales; numeric value: 1125000.0; detail: Use Shopify order records and accounting adjustments to reconcile net retail sales. Do not deduct refunds again or substitute net processor deposits for revenue.

text.title: Opening total: recognized annual retail sales

rect.title: label: Subtract landed cost of goods sold; value: −$540,000 annual expense; 48% of recognized sales; numeric value: -540000.0; detail: Include purchase cost, allocated inbound freight, applicable duties, and inventory-loss expense. Unsold inventory remains an asset until sold or written down.

text.title: Subtract landed cost of goods sold

rect.title: label: Subtract fulfillment, payments, and return handling; value: −$135,000 annual expense; 12% of recognized sales; numeric value: -135000.0; detail: Include 3PL storage and handling, outbound shipping, payment processing, and reverse logistics. Refund principal already reduces opening revenue and is not repeated.

text.title: Subtract fulfillment, payments, and return handling

rect.title: label: Subtract advertising and variable acquisition spend; value: −$180,000 annual expense; 16% of recognized sales; numeric value: -180000.0; detail: Allocate media and directly variable acquisition charges here. Retained contribution after these three expense bars is $270,000, or 24% of sales.

text.title: Subtract advertising and variable acquisition spend

rect.title: label: Subtract labor and remaining operating overhead; value: −$140,625 annual expense; 12.5% of recognized sales; numeric value: -140625.0; detail: Budget $96,000 loaded labor for two full-time seats, $24,000 for three limited-hour contractors, and $20,625 for software, insurance, and remaining overhead. Validate local staffing costs; fixed overhead averages $11,718.75 monthly.

text.title: Subtract labor and remaining operating overhead

rect.title: label: Closing total: canonical annual owner net profit; value: $129,375 residual profit; 11.5% annual net margin; numeric value: 129375.0; detail: This closing bar equals revenue less all four expense bars. Paid owner labor, if included in the pod, belongs in labor expense; personal tax treatment is not modeled.
